svg.desc: Baish Substations Package LOCATION KSA CLIENT General Electric (GE)/Saudi Electric Company (SEC) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2022 85 million SAR each DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project includes the Baish, Farsha, Muhaiyl and Wadi Ben Hashbal substations and four related extensions in KSA. Commissioned by General Electric and the Saudi Electric Company, BECT's services cover architecture, structural and civil works, MEP and technical support for the power infrastructure package. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents and site supervision.
